ja: 私は空席待ちに回された。
en: I was put on standby.
alternatives: They put me on standby.
I was added to the standby list.
point: on standby は空席が出るのを待つ状態。

ja: 私は搭乗券を見せなきゃ？
en: Must I show my pass?
alternatives: Is my boarding pass required?
Do you need my boarding pass?
point: Must I で必要か尋ねるが、会話では Do you need も自然。

ja: 隣の男性が、荷物を上げてくれた。
en: The man beside me lifted my bag.
alternatives: The man next to me lifted my bag up.
The guy next to me lifted my bag up.
point: beside me を名詞の後ろに置いて「隣の」を表す

ja: 彼、荷物を預けてる。
en: He's checking a bag.
alternatives: He is checking his bag.
He's checking in a bag.
point: 荷物を預ける は check a bag。今の動作は進行形

ja: 私が信じた確約は今では条件付きだ。
en: The guarantee I relied on is now conditional.
alternatives: The assurance I trusted now comes with conditions.
The guarantee I believed now has conditions attached.
point: I relied on は頼った確約を限定し、now conditional は今では条件付きである状態。

ja: 私は荷物を運べる。
en: I can carry bags.
alternatives: I'm able to carry bags.
I can carry the luggage.
point: can で荷物を運べると伝える。

ja: 疲れ果てて私は搭乗を逃した。
en: Exhausted, I missed boarding.
alternatives: Worn out, I missed boarding.
I missed boarding because I was exhausted.
point: Exhausted は主語の状態を添える。

ja: あの便は今、搭乗中です。
en: That flight is boarding now.
alternatives: They're boarding that flight now.
Boarding for that flight has started.
point: 「搭乗中」は is boarding。進行形で今を表す

ja: 席が空けば私が確保するよ。
en: I'll book if seats open up.
alternatives: I'll book when a seat opens up.
I'll reserve one if seats become available.
point: opens up は空きができるという意味。

ja: 係員は私の荷物が保留中だと言った。
en: Staff said my luggage was being held.
alternatives: Staff said they were holding my luggage.
They said my baggage was being held.
point: said の後で荷物が保留されているという係員の説明を伝える。

ja: ベルトは外すべきですか？
en: Should I remove my belt?
alternatives: Should I take my belt off?
Do I take my belt off?
point: 「外す」は remove か take off。should で確認

ja: 夜便で来てたら私たち今はぐったりだ。
en: Had we taken the red-eye, we'd be wrecked.
alternatives: If we'd flown overnight, we'd be exhausted now.
We'd be wiped out now had we flown overnight.
point: red-eye は夜をまたぐ便、wrecked はぐったり。

ja: 私は席を見つけられる。
en: I can find seats.
alternatives: I can locate seats.
I can find a seat.
point: can で空いている席を探せると伝える。

ja: 私の席はどこ？
en: Where's my seat?
alternatives: Where do I sit?
Which seat is mine?
point: where で座席の場所を尋ねる。

ja: 12番ゲートはどちら？
en: Where is gate 12?
alternatives: Which way is gate 12?
Where can I find gate 12?
point: 場所は Where で聞く

ja: 彼女が遅れていると言った便は、これ？
en: Is this the flight she said was delayed?
alternatives: Is this the one she said was delayed?
Is this the flight she said was running late?
point: 関係詞の中に I heard が入り込む形

ja: 窓側の席にしてください。
en: Please give me a window seat.
alternatives: A window seat, please.
Please make it a window seat.
point: 頼むときは Please で始める命令文

ja: 毛布をもう一枚ください。
en: Could I have another blanket?
alternatives: Can I get another blanket?
May I have one more blanket?
point: 「もう一枚」は another + 単数名詞

ja: ゲートが変わったと聞いた。
en: I heard the gate had changed.
alternatives: They said the gate had changed.
I was told the gate had changed.
point: 言った時点より前のことは過去完了

ja: 出るのはあの便が早い。
en: That flight leaves earlier.
alternatives: That plane takes off earlier.
That flight departs sooner.
point: earlier は時刻がより早い。

ja: 乗り継ぎを、長く取るべきだった。
en: I should've allowed a longer layover.
alternatives: I should have booked a longer layover.
I should've left more time for the connection.
point: 後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 私はもう席を選びました。
en: I've already chosen my seat.
alternatives: I've already picked a seat.
I've already selected my seat.
point: already と現在完了で席選びの完了を伝える。

ja: 席を替えていただくのは、可能ですか？
en: Would it be possible to switch seats?
alternatives: I was wondering if we could switch seats.
Is there any chance I could switch seats?
point: Would it be possible to で丁寧に頼む

ja: トイレがありますよ。
en: There's a restroom.
alternatives: We have a restroom here.
You'll find a restroom.
point: 「〜がある」は There's + 単数名詞

ja: 私は彼らが約束した便が飛ぶか疑ってる。
en: I doubt the flight they promised will materialize.
alternatives: I'm doubtful that the promised flight will actually happen.
I question whether the flight they promised will operate.
point: materialize は約束などが実際に形になること。

ja: 受付で席を変えてもらった。
en: I got my seat changed at check-in.
alternatives: I had my seat changed at check-in.
I had them change my seat at check-in.
point: have/get + 物 + 過去分詞で「〜してもらう」

ja: 私を足止めしたのは、ビザ確認でした。
en: What held me up was the visa check.
alternatives: It was the visa check that held me up.
The visa check is what held me up.
point: hold up は「遅らせる・足止めする」

ja: 書類は十分でも私には通過の保証がない。
en: Complete though my papers are, clearance is no foregone conclusion.
alternatives: Even with complete papers, I'm not assured clearance.
Having all my documents doesn't guarantee I'll be cleared.
point: a foregone conclusion は結果が既に決まっていること。

ja: 時間を気にしないなら私は乗継便を選ぶ。
en: Were time no object, I'd choose a connecting flight.
alternatives: If time didn't matter, I'd choose a connecting flight.
I'd pick a connection if time weren't an issue.
point: were を先頭にして時間の制約がない仮定を置く。

ja: 保安検査場、どこか分かる？
en: Do you know where security is?
alternatives: Could you tell me where security is?
Can you tell me where security is?
Any idea where security is?
point: where 以下は平叙文の語順（where security is）

ja: 彼女はもう入国審査を楽々通った。
en: She's already breezed through immigration.
alternatives: She's already sailed through immigration.
She's already cleared immigration without trouble.
point: breeze through は難なくすんなり通過する。

ja: 早く来れば、私たち乗れたのに。
en: We'd have boarded if we'd been earlier.
alternatives: If we'd been earlier, we'd have made it.
If we'd come earlier, we'd have made the flight.
point: 過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞 / would have + 過去分詞

ja: 私が確認を求めてたら誤解は防げたのに。
en: Had I sought clarification, I'd have forestalled the misunderstanding.
alternatives: If I'd sought clarification, I'd have prevented the misunderstanding.
I'd have averted the misunderstanding had I requested clarification.
point: forestall は問題が生じる前に先手を打って防ぐ。

ja: 私の席を窓側に変更できますか？
en: Could you reassign me to a window seat?
alternatives: Could I be reassigned to a window seat?
Could you switch me to a window seat?
point: reassign は既に決めた割り当てを変更する。

ja: 私が疑うのは優先搭乗が名ばかりかだ。
en: What I question is whether priority boarding is merely nominal.
alternatives: I question whether priority boarding is only in name.
I'm wondering whether priority boarding has any real substance.
point: nominal は名前や建前だけで実質がない。

ja: 窓側の席はございますか？
en: Would a window seat be available?
alternatives: Would there be a window seat available?
Is there possibly a window seat available?
Do you have any window seats available?
point: Would で丁寧に婉曲。Do you have より控えめ

ja: 満席でも、私は待ちます。
en: Even if it's full, I'll wait.
alternatives: Even if it's booked up, I'll wait.
I'll wait even if it's full.
point: Even if のあとは未来でも現在形

ja: ここが私の席だと思います。
en: I think it's my seat.
alternatives: I believe this is my seat.
I think this seat is mine.
point: think のあとは that 節

ja: 私の便は満席だ。
en: My flight is full.
alternatives: My plane is full.
My flight's fully booked.
point: full は空いている席がない状態。

ja: 予約した便は遅れていますか？
en: Is the flight I booked delayed?
alternatives: Is the flight I booked running late?
Has the flight I booked been delayed?
point: flight の後ろに I booked を直接つなぐ

ja: 機内にWi-Fiある？
en: Is there Wi-Fi onboard?
alternatives: Does the plane have Wi-Fi?
Is Wi-Fi available on board?
point: Wi-Fi は数えない名詞。a を付けない

ja: 乗務員に座れと言われた。
en: The crew told me to sit.
alternatives: The attendant told me to sit down.
A flight attendant told me to sit down.
point: tell + 人 + to do。to sit の形にする

ja: 乗り継ぎ逃したらどうなる？
en: What if I miss my connection?
alternatives: What happens if I miss my connection?
What if I miss the connecting flight?
point: if 節は未来のことでも現在形（miss）

ja: もう30分も待っています。
en: I've been waiting for thirty minutes.
alternatives: I've been waiting half an hour already.
I've been waiting for half an hour.
point: ずっと続いている動作は現在完了進行形

ja: 私が宣誓した申告内容は正確です。
en: The declaration I swore to is accurate.
alternatives: What I declared under oath is accurate.
My sworn declaration is accurate.
point: I swore to が自分の宣誓した申告内容を限定する。

ja: 鞄から靴を出して。
en: Remove shoes from your bag.
alternatives: Take shoes from your bag.
Get shoes from your bag.
point: remove A from B で B から A を取り出す。

ja: 乗継ぎの余裕を過信しなきゃよかった。
en: I wish I hadn't overestimated my connection time.
alternatives: If only I hadn't overestimated my connection time.
I regret overestimating my time between flights.
point: overestimate my connection time は乗り継ぎに使える時間を実際より多く見積もる。

ja: この用紙、書いてもらえますか？
en: Could you fill this out?
alternatives: Could you fill out this form?
Would you mind filling this out?
point: fill out は「記入する」。fill in も可

ja: 機内で寝るのは嫌いです。
en: I hate sleeping on planes.
alternatives: I don't like sleeping on planes.
I can't stand sleeping on planes.
point: hate のあとは ～ing の形が自然

ja: 機内食が選べるなら、魚にするのにな。
en: If I could choose, I'd have the fish.
alternatives: I'd have the fish if I could choose.
If I got to choose, I'd go with the fish.
point: 現在の仮定は If + 過去形, would + 動詞

ja: 係員は私の同意を勝手に決めつけたかも。
en: The agent might've presumed my consent without asking.
alternatives: The agent might've assumed my consent without asking me.
The agent might have taken my consent for granted.
point: presume consent は確認なしに同意があると決めつける。

ja: 私には乗継ぎの余裕などほぼない。
en: I have precious little leeway between flights.
alternatives: I have little room for delays between flights.
There's scarcely any spare time between my flights.
point: precious little はほとんどないことを強く表す。

ja: 我々は列を間違えた。
en: We joined the wrong line.
alternatives: We chose the wrong line.
We waited in the wrong line.
point: joined the wrong line は並ぶ列を間違えたことを表す。

ja: 着くと、搭乗は終わっていた。
en: Boarding had ended when I arrived.
alternatives: Boarding had finished when I got there.
The gate had closed when I arrived.
Boarding was already over when I arrived.
point: 着く前に終わっていたので had ended（過去完了）

ja: 私は到着ロビーで待つよ。
en: I'll wait in arrivals.
alternatives: I'll wait in the arrivals hall.
I'm waiting in the arrivals hall.
point: arrivals は空港の到着エリアを指す。

ja: 私は搭乗口へ急いだ。
en: I dashed to the gate.
alternatives: I rushed to the gate.
I hurried toward the gate.
point: dash は急いで駆ける。

ja: 私、荷物減らしておけばな。
en: I wish I'd packed lighter.
alternatives: If only I'd brought less luggage.
I regret packing so much.
point: pack lighter は荷物を少なくして旅の準備をする。

ja: 母が外で待っています。
en: Mom's waiting outside.
alternatives: My mother is waiting outside.
Mom is waiting out front.
point: 今待っている最中は is waiting

ja: 機内持ち込みには大きすぎます。
en: It's too big to carry on.
alternatives: It's too large for a carry-on.
This is too big for carry-on.
It's too big to bring on the plane.
point: 「大きすぎて〜できない」は too 形容詞 to do

ja: 私は手荷物規則を明確にしたい。
en: I want to clarify baggage restrictions.
alternatives: I'd like the baggage rules clarified.
I want clarity on the baggage rules.
point: clarify は曖昧な規則をはっきりさせる。

ja: 便が遅れた原因は、天候でした。
en: What delayed our flight was the weather.
alternatives: It was the weather that delayed our flight.
The weather was what delayed our flight.
The delay was caused by the weather.
point: What で始めて「〜なのは、これだ」と強調

ja: 私のパスポートです。
en: This is my passport.
alternatives: Here's my passport.
My passport is right here.
point: 「これが」は This is。物を差し出すときの定番
